title: Love Will Tear Us Apart — Ukulele Song-Form Accompaniment
description: Playable, song-structured high-G ukulele accompaniment using the documented harmony and characteristic rhythmic feel of “Love Will Tear Us Apart”. Designed for practice, not a note-for-note original guitar, vocal, bass or lead-riff transcription.
body:
Introduction: Em | Dsus4 | Bm | A (repeat 2×)
Verse 1: Em | Dsus4 | Bm | A (repeat 2×)
Chorus 1: Em | Dsus4 | D | Bm | A (repeat 2×)
Verse 2: Em | Dsus4 | Bm | A (repeat 2×)
Chorus 2: Em | Dsus4 | D | Bm | A (repeat 2×)
Middle passage: A | Em | D | Dsus4 (repeat 1×)
Final chorus: Em | Dsus4 | D | Bm | A (repeat 2×)
Outro: Em | Dsus4 | D | Bm | A (repeat 1×)
notes:
High-G GCEA, no capo; concert pitch. Brisk down-up groove with Em–Dsus4 colour and clear Bm–A resolution.
Score section map: Introduction (1–8) · Verse 1 (9–16) · Chorus 1 (17–26) · Verse 2 (27–34) · Chorus 2 (35–44) · Middle passage (45–48) · Final chorus (49–58) · Outro (59–63).
Original meter where supported; some rhythmic/meter details are adapted to the current single-meter, single-voice score engine. Rhythmic parts are original and song-characteristic, not copied riffs. Slash-bass/inversion details beyond the ukulele range are omitted.
Source harmonies: https://ukutabs.com/j/joy-division/love-will-tear-us-apart/
